text:
sarah: Quick sync — EdgeKit reported a mismatch between per-second device pulses and our marketplace hourly billing. Need a short plan for mapping pulses -> entitlements + reconciliation. Two root issues: granularity (sec->min->hour) and SKU aliasing.

vikram: Is this the same drift we saw for AcmeEdge last month or a different vector?

lucy: Different. EdgeKit devices emit 1s pulses; partner pipeline aggregates into minute buckets, then our adapter maps to an hourly SKU. In sandbox we see ~4% under-reporting vs partner's raw minute buckets.

jordan: Can we get a minimal repro: sample payload + how they batch/rollup?

sarah: Partner-provided snippet (anonymized):
```json
{"device_id":"ek-7a9","ts":"2026-02-18T13:02:17Z","pulses":1}
```
They batch to minute buckets keyed by device_id+minute, then the adaptor currently maps entire minute->hour without handling boundary minutes correctly.

vikram: Two concrete failure modes: (1) off-by-window when device ts near hour boundary (e.g., 13:59:59 -> assigned to 13:00-14:00 incorrectly), (2) SKU aliasing — partner calls it 'standard' but our marketplace SKU is 'edgekit-std-hourly' with a seat multiplier.

lucy: Proposal:
- canonical usage_key = sha256(partner_id + device_id + minute_epoch) to unify dedupe across pipelines
- idempotent writes: adapter should accept batch with usage_key and our ingest will upsert by usage_key
- signature header (X-Partner-Sig) verified against partner public key to prevent duplicate replay
- apply prorate rule for partial hours when device active < 60m (minute-level -> hour fractions)

sarah: Agreed. Also need a reconciliation job: daily rollup comparing partner-minute-aggregates vs marketplace-invoiceable-hours. If delta > 1% create a manual review ticket; below 1% auto-reconcile.

jordan: About backfills: we can't re-ingest raw pulses, but partner pushed minute-level archives to S3 for last 14 days. We can re-run adapter on those archives to compute corrected hour buckets and create adjustment transactions. Need a rollback plan if something goes sideways.

vikram: Prepare customer-facing language and check contract: does marketplace allow retro credits? Legal will need to sign-off. Draft for later: 'Redwood and EdgeKit identified a metering alignment issue affecting a subset of hourly usage; verified excess/deficit will be corrected on next billing cycle.'

lucy: Draft adapter batch schema and signing example (working draft):
```json
{"usage_batch": [
  {"usage_key":"sha256(...)","sku":"edgekit-std-hourly","qty":0.01666667,"window_start":"2026-02-18T13:00:00Z","unit":"hours"}
],
"signature":"base64sig"
}
```
Notes: qty expressed in hours (minute bucket = 1/60 = 0.01666667). We'll round qty to 8 decimal places.

sarah: Action items (owners + ETA):
- lucy: adapter schema + signing + docs (ETA 48h)
- jordan: test harness simulating boundary pulses + dashboard for delta histogram (ETA 72h)
- vikram: billing policy draft + customer note + loop in legal (ETA 48h)
- sarah: backfill plan + ops runbook + ticket templates (ETA 48h)
I'll schedule partner call tomorrow 10am PT to align.

jordan: I'll spin up a harness in eng-tools. Need S3 paths and a sample of their minute-aggregates. lucy, can you drop the sample location?

lucy: Uploaded schema & sample to /shared/partnerships/edgekit/schema-v1.json and s3://edgekit-prod-archive/partnerships/minute-agg/2026-02-*.json. Also added a small signing verifier script. Example ingestion call:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "X-Partner-Sig: <sig>" -d @batch.json https://ingest.redwood.ai/partner/usage
```
Server will validate signature, dedupe by usage_key, and increment hourly totals.

vikram: Reconciliation thresholds proposal: auto-adjust if delta <= 0.5%; create billing card if 0.5% < delta <= 2%; pause ingestion & escalate if delta > 2%. Legal might require different thresholds for credits vs invoices.

sarah: Keep thresholds conservative for now. I'll cc legal. Also Ops: create pager for partner-ingest-ops and a daily reconcile job at 00:15 UTC. Dashboard should surface per-partner delta, top devices by delta, and hour-boundary spikes.

lucy: Test matrix: timezone offsets, DST edge cases, leap-second sim, and heavy boundary load (N devices spiking at hh:00). Unit tests for rounding/accumulation to 8 decimals.

jordan: Will prototype dashboard panels: daily delta histogram, recent anomalies stream, and list of auto-adjusted invoices.

vikram: Customer note draft (for review by legal): 'Redwood and EdgeKit discovered a metering alignment issue affecting a small percentage of usage for customers on the EdgeKit integration. Verified discrepancies will be corrected on the next billing cycle; if you have questions contact support@redwood.ai.'

sarah: OK. Quick Q: who's owning partner call tomorrow? I'll host but want lucy for schema walk-through and vikram for billing. jordan please bring test harness results if ready.

lucy: :white_check_mark: I can make 10am PT, will present schema + sample payloads.

jordan: :thumbsup: I'll try to have harness basic boundaries ready.

vikram: I'll have billing policy draft and the customer note. looping legal after this thread.

sarah: Great. I'll post runbook after call and convert Action items to JIRA tickets. Thanks all.
